title: The Farmhouse Rule
hook: My grandmother had one rule about the farmhouse: never answer the door after midnight.
lines: My grandmother had one rule about the farmhouse.
Never answer the door after midnight. Not for the police. Not for family. Not even for her.
She died in March. I moved in that June.
For months, nothing happened. Then, on the first cold night of October, someone knocked.
I didn't move. I didn't breathe.
And then I heard her voice. Soft. Patient. Exactly the way she used to call me in from the yard.
Sweetheart... it's cold out here. Let me in.
My hand was already on the lock when I remembered the last thing she ever said to me, in the hospital, gripping my wrist so hard it bruised.
When I'm gone... it will know my voice.
Last night, it started using my mother's.
